subject: Personnel attestation and sample onboarding/offboarding artifacts - Nordic Telecom (EU)
messages:
From: "Svensson, Lena (Nordic Telecom)" <lena.svensson@nordic-telecom.se>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood-inference.com
Cc: procurement@nordic-telecom.se
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Personnel evidence request for SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ - Nordic Telecom (EU)

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the quick intro on the phone earlier. As part of our procurement review (SIG + CAIQ items), our security team has one focused ask related to personnel controls for any supplier accessing EU customer data. Could you please provide a short attestation and sample artifacts demonstrating the following for EU-based staff and those with EU-data access: 

- Background check methodology and a redacted sample report (name/company redacted)
- Onboarding record extract showing role + start date + access provisioning for a small cohort (CSV or PDF)
- Offboarding/audit log excerpt showing timely deprovisioning after termination
- Security training completion log (technical & privacy training)

We need this evidence for our SOC 2 review and to map to SIG question set. A one-week turnaround would be ideal — can you meet 18 Jun? Please confirm the transfer mechanism you prefer (secure Drive link or SFTP) and whether Redwood will provide an attestation letter signed by someone senior on controls. Also confirm the background-check vendor used for EU hires.

Best,
Lena
Lena Svensson
Head of Vendor Security
Nordic Telecom AB

---
Note: this request references SIG / CAIQ mappings from our procurement intake.

Hi Lena — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide an attestation plus a small set of redacted artifacts. Looping in Marissa (HR) for the onboarding/offboarding extracts and Karthik for the background-check confirmations. Priyom will coordinate redaction.

Transfer method: we prefer a secured Google Drive folder with view/download restricted to named recipients; we can also provide a one-time SFTP if your security team requires. We will aim to deliver the items you requested by end of day 17 Jun (earlier if possible) to meet your SOC 2 window.

Confirming the deliverables: 
- Redacted background-check sample (PDF)
- Onboarding cohort extract (CSV) for up to 10 EU-based starters
- Offboarding audit log excerpt (CSV)
- Training completion sample (CSV)
- Signed attestation PDF (signed by Head of Security or Head of People)

Marissa — can you prepare the CSV extracts and a redaction pass? Karthik — please confirm the background-check vendor and retention policy, and whether the attestation can reference the vendor by name.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Trust & Policy
Redwood Inference
